title: Give non-polling fenced or ambiguous launcher carries an explicit retirement policy
outcome: A finished launcher carry that stopped polling because of fencing or ambiguity does not linger with misleading capacity-eviction rerun advice.
acceptance: Decide and implement retirement with preserved reservation, or accurate lifecycle/drop disclosure, for fenced and ambiguous ordinary launcher carries that no longer poll.
Behavioral controls cover capacity pressure and nearby unmatched-launch ambiguity while preserving running-source interference refusals and native verification ownership.
